identity.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Elements of Archetype 2 (Performance Pro)
identity.vibe: Ultra-modern, premium engineering, high-tech sustainability, A+++ efficiency
identity.target_audience: Homeowners and B2B customers in the DACH region

surfaces.cards: bg-[#121212] border border-zinc-800 rounded-none sm:rounded-sm hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#00FF66] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#33FF85] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:border-[#00FF66] transition-colors rounded-none px-6 py-3

layout_strategy.marketing_pages: Use 'Tetris' grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) with heavy asymmetry. Large typography, bold green accents to signify energy efficiency, high-contrast black/white structural flow.
layout_strategy.ecommerce_shop: Use 'Control Room' grid layout for the shop. Strict, dense 1px grid lines separating products. Avoid traditional floating 'cards'; use border-collapse style. Filters on the left (col-span-3), products on the right (col-span-9).
layout_strategy.dashboard: Technical, data-heavy layout using Recharts for energy monitoring/calculators. Solid matte black background with neon green data visualizations.

component_rules.navigation: Sticky, glassmorphism header (z-50). Must include the ECO Building Technik logo, key links, Cart/Anfragekorb indicator, and a prominent B2B Login button.
component_rules.hero_section: Dark overlay (bg-black/40 to bg-black/60) on the hero image. Left-aligned, massive H1 in Cabinet Grotesk, overlapping a minimal A+++ energy badge.
component_rules.product_cards: No dropshadows. 1px solid borders (border-zinc-800). Product image takes 60% of height, sharp edges. On hover: border-zinc-500, slight -translate-y-1.
component_rules.badges: For trust symbols (Klimaförderung, A+++, 14 Tage Rückgaberecht): small pill shapes with a 1px green border and neon text.
component_rules.forms: Shadcn UI base but override to dark mode. Inputs: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-zinc-800 focus:border-[#00FF66] focus:ring-0 rounded-none.

hero_background.description: Modern house exterior at night with dynamic lighting.

product_solar.description: Modern house integrated with solar technology.

background_texture.description: Abstract green tech lines for dynamic section backgrounds.

testing_guidelines.attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, links, form inputs, and shop actions must include `data-testid` using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="cart-checkout-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text (import via Google Fonts/Fontshare).
Use pure HTML and Tailwind for marketing/hero sections to achieve the asymmetrical 'Tetris' grid layout.

Use Shadcn UI components for the e-commerce structure, cart, and dashboard, but heavily customize them to remove the 'default Vercel' look: replace rounded corners with sharp edges, remove soft box-shadows, and use solid 1px zinc-800 borders.
Implement an interactive Energy Calculator using Recharts or styled sliders.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for high-end, precise technical UI icons.
Apply 'framer-motion' for staggered entrance animations in the shop and page transitions.
Ensure total dark mode consistency—pure white text on dark grey/black surfaces with high-visibility neon green primary actions.
